asset_id.description: The asset the event belongs to; today the `ASSET` anchor resolved from the payload's vehicle identifier.

device_id.description: The telematics unit that produced the event.

driver_id.description: The driver the event is attributed to, where the tenant's policy permits storing it.

event_action.description: The TN360 action discriminator; the demo fixture carries `SE` for speed events.

event_type.description: The source event-type label, where a tenant's feed mixes event types.

external_id.description: Source-system event identity, used for idempotent re-harvest and cross-chunk de-duplication.

location_label.description: A human-readable place name or address string for the event.

occurred_at.description: When the overspeed event occurred, not when it was recorded.

position.description: The event position, carried as one value so it can never be half-populated.

position_datum.description: The datum/CRS identifier the coordinate is in (e.g. the EPSG code), plus the source frame where known.

position_precision.description: Whether the coordinate is full precision or reduced (the US ELD personal-use mode is the worked example).

recorded_at.description: When the telematics platform stamped/synchronised the event.

source_system.description: Which bound system wrote the fact.

source_units.description: The source unit per measure, where it is not the canonical unit.

speed_kmh.description: The peak speed recorded for the event.

speed_offset_kmh.description: How far over the threshold the event was.

speed_threshold_kmh.description: The speed limit or threshold the event exceeded.

trip_id.description: The trip the event belongs to, where the source supplies one.
